oracle_definition.liveness_requirement: one finalized history root per epoch T_epoch

reference_set.selection_rule: peer sovereign history streams active in the federation log

jurisdiction_diversity_fallback.meaning: Refusal to judge by jurisdictional monoculture; judge only against neutral publication history.

challenge_mechanics.reference_unpredictability_invariant: No fork can predict the reference set before challenge freeze.

economic_consequence.mechanism: capital exits or discounts fork whose history stream repeatedly resolves divergent or fallback-dependent

invariants: No fork may choose the authority that judges its own divergence.
Jurisdiction diversity failure is refusal to judge by captured legal monoculture.
Canonical Federation history fallback provides ordering and publication proof only, never semantic legal truth.
Reference-set unpredictability is the core anti-capture property.
Liquidity abandonment is an economic signal, not a federation verdict.
The federation never decides which fork is lawful; it records replayable divergence mechanics.
